get.seeds: Seeds. Plant them in a hole.
get.bucket: A bucket. Fill it at the water.
get.knife: A mushroom knife. The brush cleans.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Leave the sword. You won’t need it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You fought the dark. You won.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Help the people here. Then the garden opens.

guide.speaker: npc
guide.text: Hollis, west. Iris, by the beds. Bram and Vega, north.

gate.speaker: npc
gate.text: Go to the fire in the middle.

after.speaker: npc
after.text: You found it. A place to sit.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Four neighbours need a hand.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hollis, west. Iris, by the beds. Bram and Vega, north.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A hero. How novel. I was napping.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That branch beside me? Take it. Hold it into my fire and it wakes as a TORCH.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Two hearths in this clearing sit cold. Carry the flame to them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Burnt brush leaves CHARCOAL. Fire feeding fire — pick it up.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Friend! You look thirsty. Or dry. Either way — opportunity.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Free sample: this BUCKET. Fill it in my pond, just west of the fire.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A full bucket waters crops and drowns small fires. Endless uses. Costs you nothing. Today only.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tell your friends. If you find any out there.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The pines sing, but they crowd the verse.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This GREAT AXE fells even LIVING trees — the small axe only knows dead wood.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Open a clearing in my grove. Listen how the song changes where light falls.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Every good line needs its silence. Cut me one.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I study the fungi of this valley.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A mushroom is only the fruit. The fungus lives underground, as threads.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six kinds grow here. Bring me one at a time. Take my knife.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cut, don't pull. Brush, don't wash.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: After each cut, the knife comes back to me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: All six. You know the forest floor now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Just never eat the red one.

puffball.speaker: npc
puffball.text: East, past the water: a white ball with no cap.

inkCap.speaker: npc
inkCap.text: North-east, by the pond: tall and white, shaggy like a wig.

morel.speaker: npc
morel.text: South, by the rocks: a cap like a honeycomb.

chanterelle.speaker: npc
chanterelle.text: Far north, under the pines: a golden funnel.

flyAgaric.speaker: npc
flyAgaric.text: The north-west corner: red, with white spots. Look. Don't eat.

porcini.speaker: npc
porcini.text: Far south, by the west edge: a brown bun on a fat stem.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Everything I paint comes out grey. Real paint grows from the ground.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take the shovel: dig four holes, close by.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your painting stays here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Now I see colour everywhere.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My firewood ran out. My hands are shaking.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Green wood only smokes: it is nearly half water. Take the axe and bring four pieces of dead wood. One at a time, to the block.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Warm nights ahead.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That fire is yours too.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I want a cairn here, under the clearest sky.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Take this pickaxe. Bring me one iron bar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Iron. A place to come back to.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank you.

ore.speaker: npc
ore.text: Some rocks east of here hold ore. Break one.

furnace.speaker: npc
furnace.text: Ore needs a furnace. Build one at the bench.

charcoal.speaker: npc
charcoal.text: Set the furnace down. Two sticks make charcoal.

iron.speaker: npc
iron.text: Hammer the hot lump. Three blows.

dig.speaker: npc
dig.text: {n} to go. Shovel in the dirt.

seeds.speaker: npc
seeds.text: Four holes! The shovel stays here beside me.

seeds.speaker: npc
seeds.text: Mixed seeds: one in each hole.

sow.speaker: npc
sow.text: {n} to go. One seed in each hole.

bucket.speaker: npc
bucket.text: Fetch water from the pond, to the west, and water all four.

water.speaker: npc
water.text: {n} to go. Fill the bucket at the pond and water them.

wait.speaker: npc
wait.text: Take a walk around the valley. They grow little by little.

harvest.speaker: npc
harvest.text: Cut them with Hollis's knife, to the west. Then bring me the flowers.

easel.speaker: npc
easel.text: Brush in hand, and the canvas is yours.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The flowers go on the table. Watch how it is done.

urucum.speaker: npc
urucum.text: Annatto: I rub the seeds in water and the red powder comes off.

anil.speaker: npc
anil.text: Indigo: the leaves ferment in water. I beat it, and the blue is born in the air.

curcuma.speaker: npc
curcuma.text: Turmeric: the root, dried and ground, becomes yellow powder.

garanca.speaker: npc
garanca.text: Madder: the ground root, in warm water. Boiled, the red turns dull.

binder.speaker: npc
binder.text: Alum fixes the colour. Gum arabic makes it paint.

brush.speaker: npc
brush.text: Your kit is ready. Take the brush: the blank canvas is yours.

form.sparse: A few strokes, and it says everything.
form.middle: Look what you did on this canvas!

color.all: All four colours together. Even I would not dare.
color.urucum: That orange looks like late afternoon.
color.anil: That blue looks like deep water.
color.curcuma: That yellow warms the whole canvas.

thanks.speaker: npc
thanks.text: I only saw grey. Thank you for everything.

thanks.speaker: npc
thanks.text: I will keep the brush. The painting stays here.

chop.speaker: npc
chop.text: {n} to go on the block. Dead wood only.

split.speaker: npc
split.text: Four! Now split them: whole, they take months to dry.

split.speaker: npc
split.text: Axe in hand, at the block. Strike the grain, away from the knot.

stack.speaker: npc
stack.text: Good pieces. Stack them on the rack, off the ground.

stack.speaker: npc
stack.text: Leave gaps between them: air is what dries firewood.

dry.speaker: npc
dry.text: Now the wind does the work. Take a walk.

dryFast.speaker: npc
dryFast.text: That stack breathes. The wind will do the rest. Take a walk.

drySlow.speaker: npc
drySlow.text: Tight, see? It will dry slowly. Take a long walk.

lay.speaker: npc
lay.text: Pale and light: it is dry. One knocks on the other and it rings.

lay.speaker: npc
lay.text: Lay the fire: tinder first, then kindling, then the firewood.

businessManCraft.aim: Strike the grain, the dark line. Away from the knot.
businessManCraft.force: Now the force: the green band.
businessManCraft.knot: On the knot, the blade bounces.
businessManCraft.offGrain: Off the grain. But the crack opened.
businessManCraft.weak: Too weak. But the crack opened.
businessManCraft.strong: Too hard: the blade sticks. But the crack opened.
businessManCraft.stackHint: {n} to go. Leave gaps: watch the wind pass.
businessManCraft.airGood: Air reaches everything. It will dry fast.
businessManCraft.airOk: Some air gets through. It could be better.
businessManCraft.airBad: Too tight: no air gets through. It will take a while.
businessManCraft.layHint: From the finest to the thickest.
businessManCraft.wrongOrder: Only smoke. Flame is born in the tinder and grows through the thin.
businessManCraft.blowHint: A long, calm breath. The ember wants air.
businessManCraft.tooFast: Slowly! A hurried breath puts it out.

split.rough: Split crooked, but split. You learn an axe by swinging it.

air.good: The stack breathes. Wood like that lasts the winter.
air.ok: A crooked stack, but it breathes.
air.bad: A tight stack: it dried slowly. But it dried.

fire.worked: That fire took work. Every fire does.

thanks.speaker: npc
thanks.text: Look at my hands: they stopped shaking.

thanks.speaker: npc
thanks.text: Thank you, friend. The axe is yours.

controls.touchHint: Drag anywhere to walk · A talk & take · B use

cut.title: Cut
cut.aimKeys: Z when the blade is between the marks
cut.aimTouch: Tap when the blade is between the marks
cut.sawTouch: Swipe side to side to saw
cut.tooHigh: Too high. Cut close to the ground.
cut.tooHighVolva: Too high. Keep the cup at the base.
cut.tooDeep: Too deep. That tears the mycelium.
cut.mycelium: Those white threads are the fungus itself: the mycelium. Left in the soil, it fruits again.

clean.title: Clean
clean.why: Brush, don't wash: mushrooms soak up water.

puffball.curiosity: Rain does the work: every drop that hits it puffs out spores.
puffball.cut: Cut under the ball, at the base.
puffball.clean: Brush off the soil and loose spines.
notes: Old ones puff out a cloud of spores.

inkCap.curiosity: Within hours it melts into black ink. People once wrote with it.
inkCap.cut: Cut low on the slim stem. It's hollow.
inkCap.clean: Be quick: once picked, it turns to ink within hours.
notes: It melts into black ink full of spores.
Pick it young. It inks within hours.

morel.curiosity: It favors dying elms and old apple orchards.
morel.cut: Cut at the base. The whole thing is hollow.
morel.clean: Grit hides in the pits. Brush each one.
notes: Spores grow in tiny sacs, not gills.

chanterelle.cut: Cut at the base, just above the moss.
chanterelle.clean: Dirt hides in the ridges. Brush them out.

flyAgaric.curiosity: It was once crumbled into milk to kill flies. Hence the name.
flyAgaric.cut: Cut below the soil line. The cup at the base, the volva, is how amanitas are told apart.
flyAgaric.clean: Brush gently: the white warts rub off.
notes: The warts are scraps of its egg-like veil.
The cup at the base marks an amanita.

porcini.curiosity: A single one can weigh over a kilo.
porcini.cut: Cut at the base of the thick stem.
porcini.clean: Brush the cap. White pores underneath mean it's young.

toolbox.title: Build
toolbox.keysTouch: Tap to pick · tap to build
toolbox.keysTouchFurnace: Tap to pick · tap to smelt

opened.speaker: narrator
opened.text: A gate opens in the middle of the valley.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The marshmallow turns golden.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sword stays in the road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nowhere to be. At last.
